item.title: COSTCO MONEY 💳 How Costco Really Makes Its Money

item.title: ANCHORING BIAS 🏷️ The Black Friday Price Trick on Your Brain
item.description: The first number you see becomes an anchor, so judge a deal by its final price, not the crossed-out one.

item.title: WORLD RECORD 🏁 He Beat It, Came Third, Then Came Back (Dos Santos)
item.description: Dos Santos turned the pain of a near-miss into a clear fix: start faster, finish stronger.

item.title: YEAR REVIEW 📅 Do This Instead of Resolutions (Tim Ferriss)
item.description: Instead of resolutions, review last year's calendar and book more of your best 20% into next year.

item.title: THANKSGIVING HISTORY 🦃 Who Made It a Holiday? Sarah Hale
item.description: Sarah Josepha Hale asked for 36 years, and Thanksgiving became a national holiday in 1863.

item.title: DNA AI 🧬 Google's AlphaGenome 2 Reads DNA Cell by Cell
item.description: Context changes everything: same DNA, different cell, different result. Give AI your context too.

item.title: SLEEP HACK 📝 Fall Asleep Faster With a 5-Minute To-Do List
item.description: Spending five minutes writing tomorrow's to-do list at bedtime helped people fall asleep faster.

item.title: MAKE FRIENDS 🤝 How Many Hours It Takes to Make a Friend (Study)

item.title: LIKING GAP 🤝 People Like You More Than You Think
item.description: After a chat, people usually like you more than you think, so be kinder to yourself and reach out more.

item.title: HEDY LAMARR 📡 The Movie Star Behind the Tech in Your Wi-Fi
item.description: Hedy Lamarr's 1942 frequency-hopping idea was ignored, yet it now sits under Wi-Fi, GPS and Bluetooth.

item.title: AI NEWS 🔐 Google AI Checked Signal's Encryption in 4 Weeks
item.description: Let AI do the heavy lifting, but humans should set the goal and check the work.

item.title: FOCUS HACK 🧠 Why Task Switching Ruins Your Focus (Attention Residue)
item.description: Switching tasks leaves part of your attention behind, so finish one thing before you move on.

item.title: BUSINESS LESSON 📼 Blockbuster vs Netflix: The $50 Million No

item.title: How to Never Give Up: James Dyson's 5,127 Prototypes
item.description: James Dyson built 5,127 prototypes before one worked: every failure is data for the next try.

item.title: The Peak-End Rule: Why Endings Matter Most (Kahneman Study)
item.description: We remember experiences by their most intense moment and their ending, not by how long they lasted.

item.title: Turn Your Phone Gray to Scroll Less
item.description: Remove the color and your phone becomes less tempting to scroll.

item.description: Small mismatches between teams can sink huge projects, so agree on units and definitions first.
